- Tax/EIN: Redwood's EIN: 94-1234567. We will include CompanyTaxID and TaxAmount fields in the XML. For US buyers with no VAT, TaxAmount will be zero and we place tax lines per-state when required.
- Invoice format: attached is redwood-invoice-sample.xml. We support both PDF + structured XML. AP ingestion should be straightforward; XML fields are: InvoiceNumber, InvoiceDate, POReference, LineItems (SKU/qty/price), CompanyTaxID, TaxAmount, BillingAddress.
- Billing contact: invoices@redwood.com (primary), accounting@redwood.com (fallback).
